analysis.rationale: Net profit more than doubled YoY from Rs 383.54 lakhs to Rs 738.63 lakhs, indicating strong operational performance.
analysis.summary: Alacrity Securities reported Q1 FY27 standalone net profit of Rs 738.63 lakhs, up from Rs 383.54 lakhs in the same quarter last year, with revenue from operations at Rs 11,117.74 lakhs.
